name: manual_356702
claim: Batch verification receipts and test proofs locally and push exactly once at final convergence, keeping all active PRs in Draft state during multi-agent cross-host review cycles.

decisions.notes: Intermediate pushes trigger premature CI runs, wake up automated review bots (CodeRabbit, Greptile), and pollute PR comment threads while companion nodes are still iterating.

rationale: Intermediate pushes trigger premature CI runs, wake up automated review bots (CodeRabbit, Greptile), and pollute PR comment threads while companion nodes are still iterating.
